verdict.rationale: Claude's own docs describe Voice mode, which allows 'complete spoken conversations with Claude' on every plan across mobile, desktop and web. That covers the core of a spoken back-and-forth with the assistant. However, the feature is labeled beta and is described as built to work best from a phone. missing for 10: documentation of real-time/low-latency or natural turn-taking behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of conversation quality, non-beta status.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant

citations.quote: Voice mode allows you to have complete spoken conversations with Claude.
Voice mode is a beta feature available to all plans (Free, Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise) on Claude Mobile (iOS and Android), Claude Desktop, and the web
